rules: Use primitive components from Radix UI and style them using Tailwind CSS class utilities.
Implement design properties matching standard cn(...) class merge helpers to prevent utility overlap.
Import standard Lucide-react icons for UI button representations.
recommendedPatterns: Use Radix slot compositions for flexible link and button layouts.
Leverage tailwind-merge to clean inline class string conditionals.
componentConventions: Components should reside in components/ui/ folder structures.
Export components as standard named ESM exports.

rules: Avoid writing complex vanilla custom CSS rules, rely entirely on Tailwind CSS dynamic utility classes.
Configure HSL style variables inside CSS layers to enable seamless dark mode configuration swaps.
recommendedPatterns: Centralize core theme colors inside tailwind.config.js using HSL keys.
Utilize dynamic arbitary values only when precise local offsets are required.
componentConventions: Structure layouts with mobile-first grid columns (e.g. grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3).
Use standard viewport units for layout constraints.

rules: Leverage semantic component class names (e.g. btn, card, modal, menu) to reduce Tailwind string length.
Style layout themes matching standard HTML data-theme configuration guidelines.
recommendedPatterns: Style responsive sidebars matching daisyui collapsible drawer layout systems.
Combine daisyUI skeleton elements with local shimmer overrides.
componentConventions: Extend styling variables inside theme attributes of tailwind.config.js.
Utilize semantic alert tags for notification banners.

rules: Use Material-UI (MUI) components styled using Emotion or styled-components engines.
Override layout palettes matching standard ThemeProvider configuration profiles.
recommendedPatterns: Structure forms with MUI grid layouts and secure validator inputs.
Incorporate responsive Box wrappers for spacing parameters.
componentConventions: Import MUI widgets as separate isolated modules to optimize bundler performance.
Extend dynamic layouts matching standard grid containers.

rules: Utilize style prop utilities (e.g. px, py, bg, borderRadius) to construct responsive forms.
Extend core theme constants inside ChakraProvider configs.
recommendedPatterns: Leverage standard flex containers and layout grid systems.
Handle modal dialog overlays using standard Chakra hooks.
componentConventions: Construct all transitions using simple Chakra animation properties.
Organize complex components as grouped module files.
